data.title: 五和 · 雪景公园长椅的保温壶倒茶
data.description: 冬日落雪的公园长椅上，五和小心翼翼地从保温壶中倒出一杯热腾腾的焙茶。双手捧着茶杯递给你，在升腾的白气中缩了缩脖子，露出温柔至极的恬静微笑。
data.location: quiet park bench surrounded by snow-covered pine trees
data.action: pouring hot tea from a thermos into a cup, handing it with both hands to partner, smiling with breath fogging in the winter chill
data.lighting: crisp winter daylight reflecting on white snow
data.mood: heartwarming winter warmth, pastoral peace, supreme comfort girlfriend vibe
data.promptProse: On a snowy park bench, Itsuwa hands partner a steaming cup of hot tea with both hands, smiling sweetly in winter daylight.
data.animaCaption: Itsuwa handing partner hot tea lovingly on snowy park bench.
